summary: Dependency-confusion stub exfiltrates install host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package ships a stub whose only functional code is a beacon. package.json declares scripts.postinstall='node beacon.cjs', and index.js also invokes beacon.cjs when the module is required. beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), __dirname install path, process.cwd(), Node version) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. index.js otherwise exports a Proxy whose properties all resolve to no-op functions, so the package provides no advertised functionality beyond phoning home on install and on require. The scoped name @sxm-web/client-sdk-core combined with a stub main and no real API is consistent with dependency-confusion targeting of an internal package name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
